placements.why: The organization establishes and ratifies formal asynchronous contract specifications for job dispatch, tracking, and reaction delivery.
placements.title: Ratifying explicit asynchronous interface contracts
placements.frame: What contracts and interaction protocols govern asynchronous background jobs and data extraction?

placements.title: Replacing blocking execution with receipt-based dispatch and flexible consumption
placements.frame: How does asynchronous dispatch with cursor polling and piggybacked reactions eliminate blocking while guaranteeing fault-tolerant delivery?
placements.why: Segments src-1, src-2, and src-3 define the architectural shift to non-blocking dispatch receipts, cursor-based polling, and piggybacked reaction payloads that prevent lost work.
